fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Single Access Point
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of the street.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the driveway to maintain clear overhead and side clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Mark the location of the detached structure with a secondary address or structure marker visible from the driveway approach.
• Keep a gate or access point on at least one side of the perimeter fencing unlocked or equipped with a Knox-style lock box to allow responders to reach the rear of the property.
• Clear a walking path wide enough for responders carrying equipment between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the sides and rear of the property to allow responders to move around both structures without obstruction.
• Post a simple site map near the front entry or driveway showing the location of the detached structure relative to the main residence.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear enough that emergency vehicles can pull in and turn around without being blocked by parked cars.
• Identify and maintain an open staging area, such as the open lawn, where emergency personnel and equipment can be positioned during an incident.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Trim branches on scattered trees that hang close to or over the structure.
• Remove shrubs and low vegetation growing directly against the exterior walls.
• Keep the ground beneath scattered trees clear of dead leaves, twigs, and dry plant material.
• Maintain the open terrain areas around the structure free of accumulating dead vegetation or debris.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
